tips.text: Keep 500 Ducats and 200,000 credits in reserve between visits so you can buy it the first time it appears.
Do not buy the Zylok Incarnon Genesis for this; it is an upgrade that installs on a Zylok you already own.
Expect it back about three times a year, three to four months apart; that is a rough pattern, not a promise.
Nobody minds the price; the only annoyance is waiting for Baro to stock it.
